install.source: if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get update && (sudo apt-get install -y wpscan || sudo apt-get install -y ruby ruby-dev make gcc pkg-config libcurl4-openssl-dev); fi; if ! command -v wpscan >/dev/null 2>&1; then gem install --user-install wpscan; fi; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"; if ! command -v wpscan >/dev/null 2>&1; then gem_bin="$(find "$HOME/.gem" -type f -path '*/bin/wpscan' 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -n 1)"; [ -n "$gem_bin" ] && ln -sf "$gem_bin" "$HOME/.local/bin/wpscan"; fi
